title: Species reference record
description: MINDEX taxonomy, reference image, collection id and sequence accession where supplied. Public discovery metadata with its source.
rights_holder: Per source dataset license (MINDEX and upstream sources)
permission_basis: Published under the source's terms. No exclusivity is claimed.

title: Culture or tissue sample request
description: A physical culture held in the biobank, transferred under stated conditions.
permission_basis: Material transfer terms to be written before requests open.

title: Sequencing and analysis service
description: Sequencing of a submitted culture with the accession and report returned.

title: Licensed invention or process
description: A specific human-made invention or process, offered only under a written license naming the rights holder.
permission_basis: Requires a rights review and a named agreement. Wild species and naturally occurring DNA are not offered.
